# X Look

> X Look is a small Chrome (MV3) extension that turns x.com into a quiet, work-friendly reading list: no left navigation, no trends column, no promoted posts, a calm centred timeline, and images and videos blanked out until you click them.

It changes layout and typography only, through one content script (`x-look.css`, `controls.css`, `x-look.js`, `sort.js`) on x.com and twitter.com, with a toolbar icon (`background.js`) that switches it off and on and a box that filters posts by words, a menu that sorts the loaded posts by time, likes or likes per hour, and leaves X's light/dim/dark theme alone. No build step, no permissions beyond the content script and `storage` for the on/off switch, no data leaves the page. Releases attach `x-look.zip` to GitHub Releases; install it with **Load unpacked** in `chrome://extensions`. Licensed Apache-2.0 by [Cocode](https://cocode.dk).

## Website

- [X Look website](https://xlook.cocode.dk/): English product page
- [X Look (فارسی)](https://xlook.cocode.dk/fa/): Persian product page
- [Site llms.txt](https://xlook.cocode.dk/llms.txt): the site declares WebMCP tools (`document.modelContext.registerTool`); this file lists which pages declare them and what each tool does, so an agent on the site should call those tools rather than scrape the page
